prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME SPRITE SHEET, not concept art. Create one original blue-scarf wind swordsman animation atlas for a top-down isometric MOBA. Identity reference: the FIRST TOP-LEFT character of the reference roster only, dark ponytail, blue scarf, steel shoulder armor, katana. Ignore the other five characters. Transparent background. EXACT REGULAR GRID 6 columns by 10 rows, 60 distinct full-body sprites, no text, no borders, no contact shadows. Each cell identical size; no pose can cross its cell. Orthographic 3/4 game view, character faces screen-right throughout, camera at 35-degree downward angle. Character body same scale and boots centered on cell's (50%,85%) ground pivot in ALL standing poses. Reserve margins for katana; each body approx 65% of cell height. Painted crisp fantasy 3D-render-like sprite, muted palette, readable at 100 pixels. ROW ORDER top to bottom: 1 idle breathing 6 sequential poses; 2 RUN full stride cycle, visibly alternating planted feet/arms, 6 DIFFERENT sequential poses; 3 BASIC ATTACK katana unsheathe/windup then wide cut contact at fourth frame then follow-through/recover, 6 sequential frames; 4 Q forward sword thrust windup/contact/recovery; 5 W wind-wall sword sweep raising left hand; 6 E forward low dash thrust, pose changes not just position translation; 7 R aerial spinning katana slam then landing; 8 HIT flinch backward then recover; 9 DEATH stagger/kneel/collapse then corpse, final frame prone; 10 RECALL sheathe/meditate/hands channeling. Every row is animation of SAME character, SAME clothes, SAME sword, same view, six clearly changing poses and silhouettes. Absolutely no replicated static cutouts; limbs genuinely articulated. Minimal spell glows kept inside cells. Atlas should be tall portrait, ideally 1536x2560 or 2048x3413 preserving exact 6:10 equal-square cell grid. Genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the sprites.
